name: Cerberusmon
main_effect: [On Play] [When Digivolving] You may return 1 Digimon card with the [Dark Animal] or [Shaman] trait from your trash to the hand.
source_effect: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When an effect plays one of your Digimon, 1 of your Digimon gains ＜Rush＞ for the turn. (This Digimon can attack the turn it comes into play.)
